basic_info.description: Welcome to The Woods, a serene gated community surrounded by greenery yet centrally located in San Francisco. This stylish 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse-style condo offers 1,485 sq. ft. across three thoughtfully designed levels, combining peaceful living with easy access to public transportation, freeways, and shopping. Hardwood floors flow throughout, and abundant natural light including a skylight above the stairwaybrightens the home.    The entry level offers a spacious 2-car tandem garage with built-in shelving and ample storage.    On the main level, the living room features a gas fireplace and wine bar, with sliding doors that open to a private garden, extending the living space for seamless indoor-outdoor enjoyment. The kitchen, outfitted with stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and abundant cabinetry, connects to a bright dining area with pleasant views. A stylish half-bath completes this level. Upstairs, two en-suite bedrooms sit on opposite sides of the staircase for privacy, each with its own bathroom & generous closets. A conveniently located laundry area is found off the hallway. Residents enjoy amenities including a fitness center, sauna, & social room all while being centrally located in San Francisco with easy access to everything the city offers.
